text: All these associations, societies, brotherhoods, alliances, institutes, and so on, which must now be counted by the ten thousand in Europe alone, and each of which represents an immense amount of voluntary, unambitious, and unpaid or underpaid work, what are they but so many manifestations, under an infinite variety of aspects, of the same ever-living tendency of man towards mutual aid and support?
author: Peter Kropotkin
reference: Mutual Aid: A Factor of Evolution
locator: Chapter VIII, Mutual Aid Amongst Ourselves (continued)
